assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
raising concern for a potential transient cerebral ischemic attack
To evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be contributing to these neurological symptoms
a 48-hour Holter monitoring study is ordered
This medically necessary study is directly supported by the clinical indication note
the clinical indication note links the symptoms to the need for detecting an underlying arrhythmia
